title: Minimize tenant impact: KV rotation failure surgical livepatch
creator: Priya Desai
description: Summary: Several customers running Redwood Private in VPC/on-prem reported upgrade failures during operator-driven KV rotation step. Failure mode: a race between helm post-upgrade hooks and the operator's tenant-scoped KV snapshot/rotate job which left tenants with partially rotated keys and stale manifest pointers, causing auth failures and inference worker crashes. Impact: customer RPCs returning 503/401 for minutes-to-hours during rolling upgrades; some tenants required manual secret reconciliation. This ticket scopes a surgical livepatch and rollout plan to prevent further tenant impact and to automate remediation for already affected tenants.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Operator upgrade path is resilient: helm hooks must not trigger tenant KV rotation concurrently with operator reconcile. 2) Livepatch introduced in operator prevents KV rotate start if tenant manifests are mid-apply or helm hook pending. 3) New health-check and preflight validation detect risky in-flight upgrades and abort with safe rollback. 4) Automated remediation script can identify affected tenants and perform idempotent key-swap to restore worker auth without full rollback. 5) End-to-end test and canary run in staging demonstrating zero authentication failures during staged upgrade with simulated race conditions.
comments: 2026-03-10 Miguel A.: Triage call summary — multiple enterprise customers (CustA, CustB) hit failures during 2026.03.09 upgrade wave. Repro on k8s 1.27 with operator v2.8.1 + helm hook ordering variance. Assigned for emergency fix.

2026-03-11 Priya D.: Root cause analysis — operator reconcile triggered KV rotate concurrently with helm post-upgrade hook that rewrites tenant secrets. Observed condition: operator uses optimistic lock on CRD but helm hook acts outside controller lifecycle; race caused half-applied secret sets.

2026-03-12 Engineering notes: Proposed mitigations — (A) introduce operator-side rotate-safeguard semaphore per-tenant that refuses start if helm hook timestamp < X; (B) make helm post-upgrade hook idempotent and mark annotation when complete; (C) add onprem preflight that blocks helm apply when operator reports 'rotate-in-progress'.

2026-03-13 Miguel A.: Implemented rotate-safeguard in feature branch feature/kv-rotation-guard; added annotation reconciliation and backoff. Unit tests added. Need integration test harness with fakehelm to simulate hook timing.

2026-03-14 SRE (Liam O.): Staging canary ran across three simulated tenants: one with slow webhook latency, one with pod disruption, one normal. Observed no auth failures, KV rotate safely deferred until helm hook completed. Canary metrics: 0 5xx auth errors, rotation latency +120ms median. Preparing PR for livepatch release.
2026-03-15 PM (Asha P.): Prepare customer comms for CustA and CustB, include remediation steps and ETA for private clusters. Request approved for emergency rollout window 2026-03-17 02:00-04:00 UTC.

2026-03-15 Miguel A.: Note — added automated remediation script detect-and-heal/kvswap.sh. Script is idempotent, uses tenant lock and k8s patch, and logs to operator events. Manual run validated on staging.
2026-03-15 Security (Nina K.): Quick review — secrets handling looks safe; remediation script does not log secret material. Full security review requested post-release.
